attributes.name: Create Spiked Pit
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane skill + 2d6.

Discard this card to evade a monster you encounter whose highest difficulty to defeat is 20 or lower; you may instead bury this card to put the evaded monster on the bottom of its location deck.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 10 check to recharge this card instead of discarding or burying it.
